description: When shaping, identify initial relationships and responsibilities between core domain objects by walking through the story map. Shape the basic domain structure alongside stories.

do.description: Extract keywords from story map and identify initial relationships
do.content: Extract keywords from story titles/descriptions, identify core domain concepts, map basic relationships, document initial responsibilities

dont.description: Don't skip keyword identification or ignore domain concepts
dont.content: Skip story analysis, ignore domain terms in stories, separate story structure from domain concepts
